prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Cadmium (카드뮴) itself — the sovereign of the Cadmium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: cadmium: a soft, bluish-silver metal, zinc's younger sibling in the table, found in 1817 by a German inspector of pharmacies who wondered why a white zinc powder turned yellow when heated, and named from cadmia, an old word for zinc ore that honours Cadmus, founder of Thebes; with sulphur it becomes the blazing cadmium yellow painters love, with selenium the deep cadmium red; behind those sunny colours hides a poison that softens bones; it also swallows neutrons in reactors, and as tiny crystals it glows any colour from yellow to red according to their size alone. Palette: blazing cadmium yellow, cadmium orange-red, soft bluish silver, a sly hint of poison green.

World (fixed): year 2200, a city of quantum-dot light canvases: giant glowing wall canvases where identical tiny crystals shine every colour from yellow to crimson according to their size alone, hovering scaffolds from which light is sprayed into paintings, and sealed underground vaults with yellow hazard stripes holding the poison safely away. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her; 2) a symmetrical pair of mechanical sub-arms reaching out from her back, ending in shields or tools — her own two human arms stay as they are; 3) a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor; 4) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 5) sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables — light and precise. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): blazing cadmium yellow, cadmium orange-red, soft bluish silver, a sly hint of poison green.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): vivid cadmium-yellow hair deepening to cadmium orange-red at the tips. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Cd) and atomic number (48) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Detailed original design: Choose silhouette 3, a large equipment unit worn on her back rising above her head, with medium body armor. Signature construction: a symmetrical tall split rectangular quantum-dot light-array backpack, sealed translucent slabs tapering upward like two brushes of light; distinct gradations yellow, orange and deep cadmium red within blue-silver structural frames, green gasket seams. Body has thick fitted yellow and bluish-silver interlocking armor plates, solid angular waist guards, thigh plates, shin greaves, hard-surface boots and forearm guards, all visible joints. A mature soft oval face, warm sea-green eyes, delicate straight brows and assured gentle smile. Very long straight yellow hair with orange-red ends, side-swept bangs, two loose front braids. Face forward with one foot gently forward, two ordinary empty human hands visible at sides. On a glass pedestrian bridge overlooking the quantum-dot canvas city and sealed vault entrances, bright balanced light. Bold shoulder and chest window openings, intimate areas covered and all other body regions plated, no fabric skirts or cape. Full body eye level, all fixed brief constraints.
